renderer: deterministic browser SVG lattice with p5.js ambient field
commitThreshold: at least six samples, total path length >= 0.9, and three horizontal direction reversals
memoryRule: pending samples remain geometry-neutral; release after three reversals re-produces every rib, echo, spine, slit, and handedness
representationRupture: WEBGL loop object, DOM manuscript, and Canvas register -> generated SVG rib lattice
compositionRupture: single loop, typeset page, and upright register -> off-centre vertical profile around an open slit
encounterRupture: closed enclosure, selected words, and contradictory panels -> continuous negative-space counterstroke
temporalRupture: closure compilation and marked-word compilation -> reversal-based release
mediumRupture: WEBGL facets, DOM tokens, and Canvas leaves -> SVG paths with deterministic document memory
interactionRule: pointer/touch draws and releases; ArrowLeft/ArrowRight plus Enter/Space; Delete; Escape
